title: junellia scoparia
intro: Junellia scoparia, commonly known as the "Andean mint," is a plant species native to the Andean region, belonging to the Verbenaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, helping to alleviate digestive issues, wounds, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Junellia scoparia include calming the nervous system, reducing pain and inflammation, and supporting immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
